ChatOSS v1.21.1

## Kanban Spaces

Group your projects into Spaces — lightweight, user-named groups that act as a folder AND a filter in the Kanban library sidebar.

- A new **Spaces** section sits between Search and the Recent/A–Z control. A ＋ circle opens the create sheet: name the Space, pick a color, and check off the projects that belong to it.
- Created Spaces appear as colored bubbles. Click one and the project list scopes to its members — Recent/A–Z sorting and search keep working within the filtered list.
- An **All** pill appears once any Space exists; click it (or click the active Space bubble again) to return to the full list.
- A project created while a Space is filtered **auto-joins** that Space, so it never vanishes from the list you're looking at.
- Right-click a Space bubble to rename it, recolor it, or change its membership. Deleting a Space removes only the Space — projects and chats are untouched.
- Spaces sync across windows and persist like boards and folders.

## BYOK lifetime: clear 4th-device state

A device beyond the 3-device BYOK lifetime unlock now explains itself instead of looking like a plain Free account: Settings → Cloud shows "This device isn't registered for BYOK — your lifetime unlock covers up to 3 devices," with a button to manage devices at chatoss.ai/account → Billing. Freeing a slot unlocks the device on the next status refresh.

## Engine fix: waiting on background work is now visible

A turn that ended while a monitor or background task was still running looked stopped — the wait-for-background hold kept the "Working…" spinner up with no explanation, and the named wait rows could never render. The pane now shows **"Waiting on monitor…" / "Waiting on background tasks…"** the moment the turn settles, and completions that fired during a live turn are delivered at turn end instead of sitting stranded until the next one.
